correctness.rationale: Integration by parts yields the displayed bivariate normal truncated second moments L and R. Gaussian Markov regression propagates the quadratic terms across any finite sample, giving identical geometric weights for L and R. The sign is controlled by a positive prefactor and one even function; a strictly increasing Gaussian integral establishes one positive zero for positive serial correlation, the all-sign classification, the sharp bound and the two endpoint limits. Independent quadrature, root checks and seeded simulation replayed successfully.

value.rationale: Level upcrossing count and the total squared amplitude are canonical event-frequency and energy descriptors of Gaussian time series. Establishing exactly where their association switches direction and showing the standardized transition does not depend on sample length or marginal scale provides a nontrivial complete dependence map across natural model and threshold parameters.
